en.headline: Mid-Autumn lantern carnival returns to Victoria Park on 17 September
en.dek: LCSD’s Bing-wu lantern carnival runs free of charge from 17 to 27 September, alongside the Tourism Board’s first international lantern showcase at the same park.

zh.headline: 丙午年中秋綵燈會下週四維園亮燈
zh.dek: 康文署綵燈會9月17日至27日於維園免費開放，旅發局同期首辦國際中秋綵燈匯，文化中心露天廣場另設光影裝置至10月11日。

en.headline: Hong Kong and Uzbekistan sign gold market cooperation pact
en.dek: Christopher Hui exchanged an MOU with Uzbekistan’s central bank at the Belt and Road Summit; the two sides were due to meet again on Thursday.

zh.headline: 港與烏茲別克簽備忘錄加強黃金市場合作
zh.dek: 許正宇周三在一帶一路高峰論壇與烏茲別克央行副主席交換諒解備忘錄，財庫局周四續開雙邊會議。

en.headline: Hang Seng slips below 25,000 in morning trade
en.dek: The benchmark opened at 24,985, down 289 points or 1.15 per cent, the first break of that level in nearly six weeks, RTHK reported.

zh.headline: 恒指早市失守二萬五千關 近一個半月首見
zh.dek: 恒生指數競價時段報24,985點，跌289點或1.15%，港台報道這是近一個半月首次跌穿25,000點。

en.headline: CAVALLUNA equestrian theatre continues at Kai Tak through Sunday
en.dek: The European horse-and-theatre production, making its first Asian stop, has remaining performances at Kai Tak Arena from Thursday evening to 13 September.

zh.headline: CAVALLUNA馬術劇場啟德續演至週日
zh.dek: 歐洲馬術劇場《穿梭異境》亞洲首站在啟德體藝館上演，本周四晚至9月13日仍有場次，由香港賽馬會呈獻。

en.headline: Hong Kong and Shenzhen customs meet on new Huanggang port operations
en.dek: Acting Commissioner Woo Wai-kwan inspected joint one-stop vehicle lanes after talks with Huanggang Customs on passenger and cargo checks and emergency coordination.

zh.headline: 港深海關開會部署新皇崗口岸運作
zh.dek: 署理關長胡偉軍周三與皇崗海關關長施宏圖開會，並視察聯合一站式車道測試，雙方未公布開通日期。

en.headline: Two drivers arrested after parking row turns violent in Yau Tong
en.dek: A mixer-truck driver and a minibus driver were detained after a dispute near Sam Ka Tsuen Ferry Pier on Wednesday evening; one man was treated for a head injury.

zh.headline: 油塘泊車爭執兩司機被捕 一人頭部受傷
zh.dek: 周三傍晚三家村碼頭對開因泊車起衝突，田螺車司機涉嫌以鐵通打傷小巴司機，兩人分別涉襲擊罪被捕。

en.headline: One-year-old girl dies after being found unresponsive in Kai Tak flat
en.dek: Police were called to a Light Public Housing unit on Olympic Avenue before dawn; the child was sent to Kwong Wah Hospital and later certified dead.

zh.headline: 啟德簡約公屋一歲女嬰昏迷送院不治
zh.dek: 警方清晨接報世運道簡約公屋六座單位有女嬰昏迷，救護員送往廣華醫院搶救後證實不治，死因有待驗屍確定。

en.headline: Peking opera series opens Friday at the Cultural Centre
en.dek: The China Peking Opera Art Foundation brings three nights to the Grand Theatre from 11 to 13 September, with a Jockey Club sponsorship.

zh.headline: 香江國粹情周五起文化中心連演三晚
zh.dek: 中國京劇藝術基金會香港行9月11日至13日在文化中心大劇院上演，由香港賽馬會獨家贊助，張建國領衔。

en.headline: Observatory cancels overnight thunderstorm warning before dawn
en.dek: The alert was lifted at 4.45am after isolated storms over the New Territories; Thursday is forecast to be dry with sunny periods and a high near 32C.

zh.headline: 天文台清晨取消通宵雷暴警告
zh.dek: 警告於上午4時45分取消，新界北部清晨錄得超過20毫米雨量；周四日間大致乾燥，最高氣溫約32度。

en.headline: ZA Bank to take new Causeway Bay headquarters at Lee Garden Eight
en.dek: The virtual bank will occupy about 45,000 square feet across four floors of Tower 3, with a move planned in 2027, Hysan and the lender said.

zh.headline: 眾安銀行承租利園八期四層作新總部
zh.dek: 虛擬銀行ZA Bank將租用銅鑼灣利園八期3座約4.5萬平方呎寫字樓，料2027年啟用，遷離數碼港。

en.headline: Customs seizes HK$102 million of illicit tobacco in Kwai Chung and Kwu Tung
en.dek: Officers raided an export staging point and two packaging stores on Tuesday and arrested a local lorry driver, Customs said on Wednesday.

zh.headline: 海關葵涌古洞搗三私煙點檢逾億元貨
zh.dek: 海關周二在葵涌物流倉及古洞兩個鐵皮場檢獲約1,280萬支未完稅香煙及6,300公斤煙草，市值約1.02億元，拘捕一名本地貨車司機。

en.headline: Labour Department files 25 charges over Wang Fuk Court worker deaths
en.dek: Prosecutions under the Factories and Industrial Undertakings Ordinance target duty holders over the November fire that killed five contractor staff at the Tai Po estate.

zh.headline: 勞工處就宏福苑五名工友遇難提25項檢控
zh.dek: 勞工處經徵詢律政司後，根據《工廠及工業經營條例》向承建商、工程顧問及個別人士提出公訴，涉去年11月大埔宏福苑維修地盤火警。

en.headline: Stanley Whitney’s first Asia solo opens at Gagosian Hong Kong
en.dek: The American abstract painter’s exhibition Isn’t Love the Strangest Thing, featuring new and recent grid paintings, runs from 10 September to 7 November at the Pedder Building gallery.

zh.headline: Stanley Whitney亞洲首個個展於高古軒香港開幕
zh.dek: 美國抽象畫家Stanley Whitney的《愛難道不是奇妙無比》展出新作及近作，9月10日至11月7日於中環畢打行高古軒舉行。

en.headline: FLOCKFEST craft beer and music festival opens at PMQ this weekend
en.dek: Black Kite Brewery hosts eight Hong Kong and Japanese breweries, indie live sets and local food at the Central courtyard from Friday to Sunday, with free admission.

zh.headline: FLOCKFEST精釀啤酒音樂節本周末PMQ舉行
zh.dek: 黑鳶啤酒於中環元創方廣場舉辦為期三天的精釀啤酒與獨立音樂節，匯聚港日八間酒廠，免費入場。

en.headline: Hong Kong’s first astronaut leads live Tiangong Class for students
en.dek: Lai Ka-ying and her Shenzhou-23 crewmates delivered a 90-minute science lesson from the space station to pupils at her alma mater and campuses across Hong Kong and Macao.

zh.headline: 港產航天員黎家盈主持天宮課堂
zh.dek: 黎家盈聯同神舟二十三號乘組周三上午從空間站為港澳學生進行90分鐘直播授課，主場設於其母校荃灣公立何傳耀紀念中學。

en.headline: Medical Council rejects target time frames for handling complaints
en.dek: The watchdog told Legco a statutory requirement for milestones is unnecessary and can be handled administratively, as it responded to a government reform bill.

zh.headline: 醫委會反對投訴處理設法定時限
zh.dek: 醫委會書面回應立法會指無需在法例訂明各步驟目標時限，可按現行行政方式處理，並就政府改革草案提出意見。

en.headline: Two mainland visitors arrested as unlicensed tour guides in Sai Kung and Central
en.dek: A man and a woman, both 31, were detained in a joint Immigration Department and Travel Industry Authority operation targeting illegal guiding services ahead of Golden Week.

zh.headline: 旅監局聯同入境處拘兩名內地無牌導遊
zh.dek: 一男一女均31歲，分別在西貢東壩及中環被捕，涉嫌違反逗留條件提供導遊服務，國慶黃金周前加強執法。

en.headline: Customs seizes 5 million illicit cigarettes from high-powered speedboat
en.dek: A joint operation with mainland agencies intercepted a 16-metre boat fitted with six outboard engines off Chek Lap Kok; two mainland men were arrested.

zh.headline: 海關截高速走私快艇檢500萬支私煙拘兩人
zh.dek: 聯同內地部門在赤鱲角西北水域截獲配備六副舷外引擎的16米快艇，市值約2,200萬元。

en.headline: Buildings Department files 259 charges over Wang Fuk Court renovation works
en.dek: Two companies and four individuals face summonses over alleged use of non-fire-retardant materials and failures to supervise repairs at the Tai Po estate where 168 died last November.

zh.headline: 屋宇署就宏福苑維修工程提259項檢控
zh.dek: 兩公司及四人被控准許使用非阻燃物料及監督失當，涉去年11月大埔火災導致168人死亡的大維修工程。

en.headline: Ex-lawmaker William Wong bailed on four traffic charges
en.dek: The former legislator made a first appearance at Sha Tin Court over an alleged drink-driving crash at CUHK and must return on 11 November.

zh.headline: 前議員黃錦輝酒駕四罪提堂 准保釋至11月
zh.dek: 黃錦輝周三在沙田裁判法院首次應訊，暫毋須答辯，以5,000元現金保釋，下一次聆訊定於11月11日。

en.headline: CHP records two mpox cases; both men had high-risk contact
en.dek: A 32-year-old and a 28-year-old are stable in isolation. Officials said there is no known link between the cases or to earlier local infections.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心公布兩宗猴痘確診 情況穩定
zh.dek: 32歲及28歲男子已入院隔離，暫時未發現兩案之間或與早前本地個案有流行病學關連。

en.headline: Customs seizes HK$1 million counterfeit goods before Golden Week
en.dek: Officers searched 17 fixed hawker stalls in Yau Ma Tei and Mong Kok and arrested seven stall operators after finding about 3,100 suspected fake items.

zh.headline: 黃金周前海關油旺檢百萬元冒牌貨拘7人
zh.dek: 海關在油麻地廟街及旺角通菜街搜查17個固定小販檔，檢約3,100件懷疑冒牌物品，拘捕7名檔主。

en.headline: Symphony of Lights paused from Wednesday until further notice
en.dek: The Tourism Commission said the nightly Victoria Harbour light-and-music show is suspended from 9 September, with no restart date given.

zh.headline: 幻彩詠香江即日起暫停直至另行通知
zh.dek: 旅遊事務署公布，維港兩岸燈光音樂匯演由9月9日起暫停，未交代恢復日期。

en.headline: Sun says government will help firms run childcare in Northern Metropolis
en.dek: Labour chief Chris Sun told RTHK workplace centres there could follow the airport preschool model, as the city looks for more places for children under two.

zh.headline: 孫玉菡：政府支援企業在北部都會區開設託兒
zh.dek: 勞福局長接受港台訪問時表示，北部都會區託兒可參考機場員工幼兒中心模式，並重申會增加兩歲以下名額。

en.headline: Oman’s Sohar International to open Hong Kong office this week
en.dek: Sources say the Omani lender will open a representative office at Cheung Kong Center II in Central, its first presence outside the Middle East.

zh.headline: 阿曼Sohar銀行本周擬在中環開設代表處
zh.dek: 消息指阿曼第二大銀行將於長江集團中心二期開設代表處，是該行首次在中東以外設點，開幕儀式料周四舉行。

en.headline: Wear's HK designer pop-ups run at six sites through mid-September
en.dek: Twenty Hong Kong labels are in temporary shops at Harbour City, ifc mall, Pacific Place, Hysan Place, Festival Walk and the airport until 14 September.

zh.headline: 「Wear's HK」六區時裝快閃店開至9月14日
zh.dek: 香港時裝薇項目於海港城、ifc、太古廣場、希慎、又一城及機場設20個本地設計師快閃點，部分點只開至本周末。

en.headline: M+ opens Herzog & de Meuron architecture display on Saturday
en.dek: Models, drawings and material samples from the Swiss firm that designed M+ and Tai Kwun go on view in the Focus Gallery from 12 September to 10 January.

zh.headline: M+周六起展出Herzog & de Meuron建築捐贈
zh.dek: 設計M+及大館的瑞士事務所向博物館第二期捐贈的模型、繪圖及物料樣本，9月12日至明年1月10日於二樓焦點空間展出。

en.headline: Fire Services seize 7,984 litres of diesel at Kwu Tung site
en.dek: A task force targeting illegal refuelling found an unlicensed filling point on Kwu Tung Road on Monday and will prosecute two men under fire-hazard and dangerous-goods laws.

zh.headline: 消防古洞路搗非法油站 檢近8,000公升柴油
zh.dek: 消防處打擊非法燃油轉注特遣隊周一在古洞路發現非法加油站，檢獲7,984公升柴油，市值約29.2萬元，兩名男子將被檢控。

en.headline: Sixth round of HK$18 elderly tea vouchers starts 16 September
en.dek: Chief Secretary Eric Chan said more than 200 elderly centres will issue eight-voucher packs to about 70,000 older people, redeemable from 1 October at eight restaurant groups.

zh.headline: 第六輪長者18元下午茶券下周三起派發
zh.dek: 政務司司長陳國基表示，全港逾200間長者中心將向約7萬名長者派發每套8張餐券，10月1日至11月30日可到8間飲食集團以18元用指定下午茶。

en.headline: Youdi Robotics jumps more than 140 percent on Hong Kong debut
en.dek: The Wuxi-based commercial service-robot maker opened at HK$35 against an issue price of HK$14.45 after its public offer was about 140 times subscribed.

zh.headline: 優地機械人港股上市高開逾1.4倍
zh.dek: 無錫商用服務機械人公司優地機械人（03231）周三掛牌，開市報35港元，較招股價14.45港元升約142%，公開發售超購約140倍。

en.headline: Customs seizes HK$13 million of drugs from three airport passengers
en.dek: Officers at Hong Kong International Airport arrested three incoming travellers on Tuesday and seized about 25kg of suspected ketamine and 13kg of suspected cannabis buds.

zh.headline: 海關機場破三宗旅客販毒案 檢1300萬元K仔及大麻
zh.dek: 海關周二在香港國際機場先後截獲三名入境旅客，檢獲約25公斤懸疑氯胺酮及13公斤懸疑大麻花，市值約1,300萬元。

en.headline: Tai Kwun Hong Kong movie exhibition runs into early October
en.dek: Better Together – Partnering Up for Hong Kong Movies is on at the Duplex Studio in Central through 4 October, with replica sets and interviews from film crews.

zh.headline: 大館港產片「拍住上」展覽展至10月4日
zh.dek: 大館夏季展覽「拍住上—光影裡並肩馳馳的我們」在中環01座複式展室舉行至10月4日，重現經典對手戲場景及道具複製品。

en.headline: Labour chief says new childcare places will target infants under two
en.dek: Chris Sun said subsidised standalone child care centre places should nearly double by the end of 2029, with extra capacity aimed at the 0-to-2 age group.

zh.headline: 孫玉菴：新增幼兒中心名額將集中0至2歲
zh.dek: 勞福局長表示，資助獨立幼兒中心名額料於2029年底前增加約1,500個、接近翻倍，新增資源會盡量投放在0至2歲嬰幼兒。

en.headline: CHP records severe paediatric flu case as vaccination drive nears
en.dek: A five-year-old boy with long-term illness is stable in paediatric intensive care with influenza A (H1) complicated by severe pneumonia, the Centre for Health Protection said.

zh.headline: 再錄兒童嚴重流感個案 疫苗計劃下週展開
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心公布，一名有長期病患的五歲男童確診甲型H1流感併發嚴重肺炎，現於兒童深切治療部留醫，情況穩定。

en.headline: Police raid village-house etomidate workshop in Lok Ma Chau
en.dek: Border District officers say they seized 5,960 suspected liquid etomidate cartridges worth more than HK$1.5 million and arrested a 40-year-old man.

zh.headline: 警搗落馬洲村屋依托咪酯工場 檢近六千煙彈
zh.dek: 邊界警區周一晚搜查落馬洲料壘村分租單位，檢獲5,960粒懷疑液態依托咪酯煙彈，市值逾150萬元，並拘捕一名40歲男子。

en.headline: Driver dies after private car hits central divider in Fanling
en.dek: A man in his 50s was trapped after a car left the carriageway on Pak Wo Road on Tuesday night; police later found suspected drug-taking equipment in the vehicle.

zh.headline: 粉嶺百和路私家車撞壘 司機送院不治
zh.dek: 周二晚一輛私家車在粉嶺百和路近蓬瀛仙館失控撞向路中石壘，50多歲司機被困送院後不治；警方其後在車內檢獲懷疑吸毒工具。

en.headline: Cats extra shows at Xiqu Centre run through Sunday
en.dek: Andrew Lloyd Webber’s musical ends its Hong Kong engagement on 13 September after added performances at the West Kowloon Grand Theatre.

zh.headline: 音樂劇《貓》西九戲曲中心加場演至周日
zh.dek: 安德魯勞伊韓伯原版製作於西九戲曲中心大劇院的香港站，終極加場至9月13日結束。

en.headline: 2027 DSE registration opens Friday; GBA centres extended three years
en.dek: The HKEAA will take entries from 11 September to 7 October and is studying an increase in mainland participating schools from four to 12.

zh.headline: 2027文憑試周五起報名 內地試場續試行三年
zh.dek: 考評局公布9月11日至10月7日接受報名，並探討將大灣區內地與考學校由4所增至12所。

en.headline: HKTDC takes Hong Kong Shopping Festival to Singapore and Malaysia
en.dek: After the mainland edition drew 115 million views, the first ASEAN edition runs from 21 to 27 September on Shopee and Lazada with about 100 Hong Kong brands.

zh.headline: 香港好物節首次登陸星馬電商 9月21日起舉行
zh.dek: 內地站總瀏覽人次逾1.15億後，貿發局將於9月21至27日在新加坡及馬來西亞Shopee、Lazada推出東盟站，約100個港商品牌參與。

en.headline: 11th Belt and Road Summit opens in Hong Kong today
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee said the two-day forum, themed on high-quality development, will continue to leverage the city’s advantages under “one country, two systems” to support the initiative.

zh.headline: 第十一屆一帶一路高峰論壇今開幕
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超表示，論壇以「推動高質量發展 共啟新征程」為主題，香港將繼續發揮「一國兩制」優勢助力倡議。

en.headline: Hong Kong’s first chief executive Tung Chee-hwa dies aged 89
en.dek: The former shipping tycoon and CPPCC vice-chairman passed away peacefully on Tuesday evening surrounded by family, his office said in a statement issued early Wednesday.

zh.headline: 香港首任行政長官董建華離世 享年89歲
zh.dek: 董建華辦公室凌晨發聲明，指前全國政協副主席、首任行政長官於周二晚安詳辭世，摯親隨侍。

en.headline: Customs seizes 6.1 tonnes of drugs worth HK$1.4 billion in summer airport operation
en.dek: A four-month joint campaign with mainland and overseas agencies detected 424 cases and arrested 150 people, many of them young adults recruited during the holiday peak.

zh.headline: 海關暑期機場緝毒行動檢6.1噸毒品值14億元拘150人
zh.dek: 與內地及海外21個執法機構聯合行動四個月，破424案，約七成被捕者為18至40歲青年。

en.headline: Heritage Museum opens Leslie Cheung 70th-birthday exhibition today
en.dek: More than 300 artefacts, including rarely seen stage costumes and a recreated room from the late star’s home, go on free display in Sha Tin until May 2027.

zh.headline: 文化博物館張國榮70誕辰展今日開幕
zh.dek: 逾300件展品包括罕見舞台服裝及故居場景重現，即日起至2027年5月10日於沙田免費開放。

en.headline: Hong Kong astronaut leads Tiangong Class for HK and Macau students today
en.dek: Lai Ka-ying and her Shenzhou-23 crewmates will deliver a live space lecture from the Tiangong station starting at 9.50am, with schools encouraged to watch the broadcast.

zh.headline: 天宮課堂港澳專場今早舉行 黎家盈與學生天地對話
zh.dek: 神舟二十三號乘組包括港產航天員黎家盈，將於上午9時50分起為港澳學生進行太空授課及科學實驗示範，教育局鼓勵學校安排師生收看直播。

en.headline: Uber plans Hong Kong ride-hailing licence application by end of October
en.dek: The platform’s local general manager said preparation is on track under the new regulatory regime, while Hong Kong users continue to drive strong demand for its Macau service.

zh.headline: Uber料十月底前申請本港網約車牌照
zh.dek: 本地總經理表示正按新規管要求籌備，進度理想；同時指香港乘客仍是其澳門服務的最大用戶群。

en.headline: Customs seizes HK$10.85 million illicit cigarettes in Kwai Chung raid
en.dek: Officers found about 2.41 million sticks in an industrial-building unit and arrested three men aged 32 to 36 who are now on bail pending further inquiries.

zh.headline: 海關葵涌工廈破私煙倉 檢1085萬元貨拘3男
zh.dek: 關員在工業大廈單位檢獲約241萬支懷疑私煙，市值約1085萬元，應課稅值約798萬元；三名32至36歲男子被捕，已保釋候查。

en.headline: Hong Kong students slip in PISA rankings but stay above global average
en.dek: Science falls out of the top 10 for the first time while digital-learning scores rank sixth; Education Bureau notes scores remain above OECD means and will review the findings.

zh.headline: PISA港生數學科學閱讀排名齊跌 仍高於國際平均
zh.dek: 科學首次跌出全球前十，數碼學習領域排名第六；教育局指三個核心範疇得分仍高於經合組織平均，將檢視結果。

en.headline: Shenzhen-Hong Kong-Guangzhou cluster retains top global innovation ranking
en.dek: The World Intellectual Property Organization’s 2026 Global Innovation Index again places the cluster first, citing patent filings, scientific publications and venture-capital deals; the Hong Kong government welcomed…

zh.headline: 深圳—香港—廣州創新集群連續第二年全球排名第一
zh.dek: 世界知識產權組織《2026年全球創新指數》再次將該集群列為全球首強，指標包括專利、科學論文及風險投資；特區政府表示歡迎。

en.headline: ICAC charges four over alleged conflict of interest at AlipayHK operator
en.dek: Two former employees of the Ant Group subsidiary and their spouses are accused of concealing interests and securing an app-development contract for a company they controlled; they face conspiracy-to-defraud charges on…

zh.headline: 廉署起訴AlipayHK兩前僱員及配偶涉隱瞞利益衝突
zh.dek: 兩名前僱員被指出資經營應用程式開發商並安排配偶任董事，誘使公司將「醫健約」小程式合約外判予該公司；四人被控串謀詐騙，周四提堂。

en.headline: MTR reports mass fare evasion at Tsim Sha Tsui station to police
en.dek: A viral video showed groups of people tailgating through exit gates after a single card tap on 23 August; the operator said it has stepped up patrols and will pursue prosecutions where appropriate.

zh.headline: 港鐵尖沙咀站集體逃票報警 片段顯示一次拍卡多人出閘
zh.dek: 網上片段顯示8月23日晚有人拍一次卡後多人尾隨出閘，最多一次達7人；港鐵已報警並加強巡查，強調逃票可被檢控。

en.headline: Hong Kong non-exchange-traded product sales hit record HK$9.9 trillion in 2025
en.dek: A joint SFC-HKMA survey showed a 63 per cent rise driven by strong demand for fixed-income, currency and commodity products and record market participation.

zh.headline: 去年非交易所買賣投資產品銷售創9.9萬億元新高
zh.dek: 證監會與金管局聯合調查顯示按年急升63%，受惠於固定收益、貨幣及商品產品需求強勁及市場參與度破紀錄。

en.headline: Record 16 young Hong Kong officers recommended for UN Junior Professional posts
en.dek: The third batch, drawn from 12 government departments and bureaux, will begin two-year assignments this month at UN headquarters and offices in Geneva, Vienna and Nairobi.

zh.headline: 歷來最多16名青年公務員獲推薦赴聯合國任職
zh.dek: 第三批人員來自12個政府部門及政策局，本月起陸續啓程，於聯合國總部及日內瓦、維也納、內羅畢辦事處擔任兩年職位。

en.headline: Black Kite’s Flockfest brings craft beer and indie music to PMQ this weekend
en.dek: The three-day free-entry festival from 11 to 13 September features eight Hong Kong and Japanese breweries, more than 50 beers, local food and live sets by 15 indie acts.

zh.headline: 黑鳶Flockfest周末PMQ舉行 精釀啤酒與本地獨立音樂
zh.dek: 9月11至13日於中環元創方免費入場，匯聚港日八間酒廠逾50款啤酒、本地美食及15組獨立音樂單位。

en.headline: Development chief says Queen Mary lift shafts have dimensional deviations
en.dek: Secretary Ning Hoi-tak said installation workmanship, damaged components and shaft wall size errors are being fixed, with rectification expected in the fourth quarter and costs borne by the contractors.

zh.headline: 甯漢豪：瑪麗醫院𨋢槽外牆尺寸有偏差 料第四季完成執修
zh.dek: 發展局局長表示升降機問題涉及安裝工藝、部件破損及井道外牆尺寸偏差，當局有信心今年第四季完成執修，費用由承建商支付。

en.headline: Female officer burned after paper shredder fire at Wan Chai police HQ
en.dek: A shredder ignited inside an office in the West Wing of Police Headquarters shortly before 11am; the officer was taken conscious to Ruttonjee Hospital with facial and arm burns.

zh.headline: 灣仔警總碎紙機起火 女警面及手燒傷送院
zh.dek: 今早近11時警察總部西翼辦公室碎紙機起火，一名女警面部及雙手前臂燒傷，清醒送往律敦治醫院。

en.headline: LCSD Mid-Autumn lanterns light Victoria Park from 17 September
en.dek: The carnival at Victoria Park runs to 27 September, with a separate lighting display at the Cultural Centre piazza until 11 October; both are free after dusk.

zh.headline: 康文署中秋絲燈會9月17日起亮燈維園
zh.dek: 維多利亞公園絲燈會舉行至9月27日，文化中心露天廣場光影裝置展至10月11日，黃昏後免費參觀。

en.headline: Women’s rugby series at Kai Tak awarded M Mark status
en.dek: The Major Sports Events Committee recognised the WXV Global Series Challenger, which opens on Sunday with three matches at the Kai Tak Youth Sports Ground.

zh.headline: 女子欖球挑戰賽獲M品牌 周日啟德揭幕
zh.dek: 大型體育活動事務委員會向WXV全球系列挑戰賽頒授M品牌認可，周日起一連三個比賽日在啟德青年運動場上演。

en.headline: Longsys H shares open at issue price on Hong Kong debut
en.dek: Shenzhen memory-chip maker Jiangbolong listed as 09976 at HK$236 a share after a public offer about 40 times subscribed, and opened flat before slipping a little.

zh.headline: 江波龍港股掛牌平開報236元
zh.dek: 深圳存儲器廠商江波龍今日以09976代號在港上市，發售價每股236元，公開發售約超購40倍，開市報發行價後輕微低水。

en.headline: LCSD books Charles Ng saxophone recital at City Hall in October
en.dek: Tickets at $220 went on sale for the 8 October concert in the Hong Kong Artists series, which includes two Asian premieres and a new work with composer Charles Kwong.

zh.headline: 康文署十月大會堂呈獻吳漢紳色士風演奏會
zh.dek: 「香港藝術家」系列演奏會定於10月8日晚上8晈在香港大會堂劇院舉行，票價220元已於城市售票網開售，節目包括兩首亞洲首演及一首世界首演。

en.headline: Jockey Club launches HK$134 million community basketball scheme
en.dek: A five-year programme unveiled on Monday will offer nine-month training in all 18 districts for children aged six to 16, with former NBA player Yao Ming among the guests at the kick-off.

zh.headline: 馬會撥逾1.34億推五年社區籃球計劃
zh.dek: 賽馬會「傳承接力」社區籃球計劃周一啟動，將於18區為6至16歲兒童及青年提供每年九個月訓練，前NBA球星姚明出席典禮。

en.headline: CHP records three new Legionnaires’ cases; EMSD flags three towers
en.dek: Health officials reported three community-acquired infections in a week to 5 September, while the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department found three cooling-tower samples above its action level in August.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心一周錄三宗軍團菌病 機電署三冷卻塔超標
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心公布8月30日至9月5日錄得三宗社區感染軍團菌病；機電工程署八月例行抽檢發現三個冷卻塔水樣本達行動水平。

en.headline: HZMB fresh-food clearance to run 24 hours from 1 October
en.dek: The Centre for Food Safety will extend operating hours for designated Mainland produce arriving via the bridge from the present 16-hour window, after talks with Mainland authorities and the trade.

zh.headline: 港珠澳大橋鮮活食品10月1日起全日通關
zh.dek: 食安中心公布，經港珠澳大橋進口指定內地鮮活食品的通關時間由10月1日零晈起由每日16小時延長至全日24小時。

en.headline: Observatory issues Very Hot Weather Warning on Tuesday morning
en.dek: The warning was issued at 6.45am as the city heads for a mainly sunny and very hot day, with urban highs of about 33 degrees and isolated afternoon showers.

zh.headline: 天文台今早發出酷熱天氣警告
zh.dek: 天文台上午6晈45分發出酷熱天氣警告，預料今日大致天晴，日間酷熱，市區最高氣溫約33度，下午局部地區有驟雨。

en.headline: Ultraman 60th-anniversary exhibition in Mong Kok ends Sunday
en.dek: The Ultra Heroes Exhibition 2026 at INCUBASE Arena in Chong Hing Square closes on 13 September after a summer run of costumes, props and reconstructed Six Ultra Brothers scenes.

zh.headline: 旺角超人英雄展本周日結束
zh.dek: 慶祝超人系列60周年的《超人英雄展2026》在旺角創興廣場INCUBASE Arena展出至9月13日，展出拍攝用皮套、道具及昭和超人六兄弟場景。

en.headline: HKMA consults on next phase of sustainable finance taxonomy
en.dek: The Monetary Authority's Phase 2B prototype expands the list of defined green and transition activities from 25 to 39 and adds shoreline and flood measures, with comments due by 7 October.

zh.headline: 金管局就可持續金融分類目錄第2B階段諮詢
zh.dek: 金管局公布第2B階段原型，將綠色及轉型經濟活動由25項增至39項，並加入海岸及防洪適應措施，公眾可於10月7日前提交意見。

en.headline: Communications Authority fines Commercial Radio HK$120,000
en.dek: The watchdog said the AM864 English channel missed required hourly news and weather bulletins at set hours from May 2022 to April 2026 and filed inaccurate compliance records.

zh.headline: 商台英語頻道漏播新聞天氣 通訊局罰12萬
zh.dek: 通訊事務管理局裁定，商業電台AM864台由2022年5月至今年4月在指定時段未有每小時播放新聞及天氣報道，並曾提交不準確合規紀錄。

en.headline: Police seek two men after Yau Ma Tei car hits three vehicles
en.dek: A private car fled a restricted-zone stop on Nathan Road on Monday afternoon, striking two cars and a taxi; an officer was hurt trying to smash a window and the vehicle was later found abandoned in Hung Hom.

zh.headline: 油麻地私家車拒查連撞三車 警追緙兩男
zh.dek: 一輛私家車周一傍晚在彌敦道限制區落客遇查後逃走，先後撞及兩輛私家車及一輛的士，一名警員扑窗時受傷，車輛其後在紅磡被發現，車內無人。

en.headline: Reports: HZMB Hong Kong Port to trial in-car clearance in December
en.dek: Immigration is preparing a Smart Passage pilot so registered private-car drivers and passengers can clear the border without leaving their seats or showing documents, several newspapers reported.

zh.headline: 據報港珠澳口岸12月試行車上智通行
zh.dek: 多份報章報道，入境處擬於12月在港珠澳大橋香港口岸推出「智通行」先導計劃，合資格跨境私家車司機及乘客毋須下車或出示證件即可過關。

en.headline: Cavalluna equestrian show opens tonight at Kai Tak Arena
en.dek: Europe’s large-scale horse theatre production makes its Asian debut with eight performances through 13 September, presented with the Hong Kong Jockey Club.

zh.headline: 歐洲馬術劇場Cavalluna今晚啟德首演
zh.dek: 大型馬術劇場《Cavalluna – 通往異世界之門》今晚起在啟德體藝館上演，一連五天共八場，為其亞洲首演。

en.headline: Disciplinary hearings for Wang Fuk Court fire contractors postponed
en.dek: The Fire Services Department said the Registered Fire Service Installation Contractors Disciplinary Board has deferred the hearings against two companies linked to the Tai Po blaze.

zh.headline: 宏福苑兩消防承辦商紀律聆訊押後至另行通知
zh.dek: 消防處公布，原定周五就宏福苑大火兩間涉事消防裝置承辦商進行的紀律聆訊已獲委員會接納押後。

en.headline: Customs seizes 200 live crickets and 13kg of cockroaches at Lo Wu
en.dek: Two travellers were arrested after officers found the insects, commonly used as pet feed, in their baggage at the border checkpoint over the weekend.

zh.headline: 海關羅湖檢200隻活蟋蟀及13公斤蟑螂 拘兩旅客
zh.dek: 海關周末在羅湖管制站截獲兩名旅客，行李內分別藏有活體蟋蟀及杜比亞蟑螂，估計市值共約5,900元，兩人已被捕。

en.headline: FEHD prosecutes Kwai Chung café over hygiene after live mouse in takeaway
en.dek: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department inspected a factory canteen in Kwai Chung after a customer reported a live young mouse in a takeaway order and found hygiene shortcomings, leading to an immediate…

zh.headline: 葵涌冰室外賣現活鼠 食環署指衞生欠佳已檢控
zh.dek: 食環署接獲投訴指市民在葵涌一間食肆購買的外賣發現懷疑幼鼠後即時巡查，發現部分地方衞生欠佳，已向經營者提出檢控並要求即時改善。

en.headline: Customs seizes 23.5kg of drugs from two passengers at airport
en.dek: Hong Kong Customs arrested a Japanese man and a British man after finding suspected cocaine and ketamine worth about HK$11 million in their baggage on Sunday; both face court on Tuesday.

zh.headline: 海關機場破兩宗販毒案 檢約23.5公斤毒品拘兩男
zh.dek: 海關周日在香港國際機場檢獲約7.5公斤懷疑可卡因及約16公斤懷疑氯胺酮等，市值約1,100萬元，拘捕一名日本籍及一名英國籍男子，兩人周二提堂。

en.headline: Science Park launches first co-create co-invest summit and fund investments
en.dek: Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation opened a six-day event linking founders, investors and industry, and announced the first investments from its HK$500 million co-acceleration fund.

zh.headline: 科技園首辦共創共投峰會 公布5億元基金首批投資
zh.dek: 香港科技園公司一連六日舉辦共創共投產業加速峰會，並公布共同企業加速基金首批四個投資項目，涵蓋氫能、物聯網及人工智能機械人等。

en.headline: Subcontractor owner admits bribery over airport third-runway contracts
en.dek: The proprietor of Carol Engineering pleaded guilty to five charges involving more than HK$5 million while a former Airport Authority general manager denied a related conspiracy charge and went on trial.

zh.headline: 機場三跑分判商東主認串謀行賄 涉逾500萬元
zh.dek: 卡樂工程東主吳啟安承認五項行賄罪，涉款逾500萬元；機管局前總經理殷國強否認控罪受審，案件押後至周二。

en.headline: Hong Kong foreign reserves stand at US$442.9 billion at end-August
en.dek: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said official foreign currency reserve assets fell from US$447.9 billion at the end of July, remaining equivalent to more than five times the currency in circulation.

zh.headline: 八月底外匯儲備資產4429億美元
zh.dek: 金管局公布，香港於八月底官方外匯儲備資產為4429億美元，較七月底的4479億美元回落，仍相當於流通貨幣五倍多。

en.headline: Two travel agencies and guide lose licences over coerced shopping
en.dek: The Travel Industry Authority revoked the licences of Go Go Ming Travel Services, Grandee Travel Company and guide Sun Kwun-ying with immediate effect after finding failures to prevent coercion of mainland tour groups.

zh.headline: 兩旅行社及導遊涉威迫購物被撤銷牌照
zh.dek: 旅遊業監管局即日起撤銷幗名旅遊、伯爵旅行社的旅行代理商牌照及導遊孫觀英的牌照，指未有防止內地旅行團被威迫購物。

en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning in force until mid-afternoon
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Thunderstorm Warning at 12.55pm, later extended, with isolated thunderstorms expected over the territory.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告生效至下午中段
zh.dek: 天文台下午12時55分發出雷暴警告，其後延長有效時間至下午4時15分，預料本港有局部地區雷暴。

en.headline: Beijing robotics firm plans dozens more autonomous retail stores in Hong Kong
en.dek: Galaxy Universal, which already operates fully autonomous shops in Kai Tak, Hung Hom and Wan Chai, aims to expand into tourist areas including theme parks.

zh.headline: 銀河通用擬在港增設數十家全自主機器人零售店
zh.dek: 公司已在啟德、紅磡及灣仔開業，計劃拓展至人流密集區及主題樂園，並增加產品種類。

en.headline: Environment secretary heads to Beijing for APEC energy ministers’ meeting
en.dek: Tse Chin-wan will also meet officials from the Ministry of Ecology and Environment and the National Energy Administration during the five-day visit.

zh.headline: 謝展寰赴京出席APEC能源部長會議
zh.dek: 環境及生態局局長今午啓程，期間將與生態環境部及國家能源局官員會面，周五返港。

en.headline: Didi plans autonomous vehicle tests in Tseung Kwan O this year
en.dek: A government adviser said the mainland ride-hailing firm will apply for a pilot licence, with initial trials likely starting in the industrial estate.

zh.headline: 滴滴擬今年申請將軍澳無人駕駛測試牌照
zh.dek: 運輸署工作組成員表示，內地網約車巨頭擬申請自動車先導牌照，初步測試或先於工業邨展開。
